basic_info.description: Enjoy city living in this stylish & sleek 1 BD + home office/guest room condo in a 12-unit luxury boutique building constructed in 2010. Located in Lower Nob Hill/Downtown SF, the unit is an ideal home or pied-a-terre for those seeking contemporary living in the heart of the city. This sophisticated modern home features an open floor plan, floor-to-ceiling windows, white oak floors and overlooks the shared courtyard. Gourmet kitchen is equipped with Italian cabinetry, stainless steel appliances and stone counters. The spa-style bath features Italian cabinetry, stone counters, double-vanity and an oversize walk-in rain shower. State of the art technology includes CAT5 wiring, pre-installed audio speakers, security system and lobby intercom. Closets include custom built-ins and a Bosch washer/dryer. An additional storage and one designated parking space in the garage complete the unit. Walk Score 99. 2 blocks to Grace Cathedral and 3 blocks to Union Square. Walkable to Financial District
